_about: F64 THE GALAXY-BLACK LOOK (the final shift, rank 50 — design/story.md: 'all the goop is galaxy black — black with shimmering stars'). How black goop (shift.json's 7th colour, which only comes at rank 50) and black cracks LOOK, in both goo styles (Jelly + Particle, src/goo/shared/galaxyLook.ts) and on the tank canvas (cracks, ghost, arrows, the next window). Looks only: nothing here changes a rule. The risk is black on the dark tank, so the body is a deep night-blue with nebula clouds, its edge glows and a soft halo rings each clump. On the looks clock; live in the Dev Kit.

_help.body: The galaxy's night colour (the deep part of the goop).
_help.nebula1: The first nebula cloud colour drifting through it.
_help.nebula: How strong the nebula clouds are (0 = plain night).
_help.nebulaSize: How big the nebula clouds are (cells).
_help.drift: How fast the clouds and stars drift (cells a second; 0 = still).
_help.rim: The glow colour round the edge of black goop (and black cracks) — what makes black read on the dark tank.
_help.rimGlow: How bright that edge glow is.
_help.halo: A soft glow just outside each black clump, in the rim colour (0 = none).
_help.starSize: How big the stars are (1 = normal).
_help.twinkle: How fast the stars twinkle (0 = steady).
_help.crackStars: Black cracks on the tank wall: how many stars twinkle along each one.
_help.crackCore: Black cracks: the colour of the crack's dark middle (its glow is the rim colour).
